scope: Receipt-bound read-only bootstrap source. Drafts intentionally disabled/unapproved; root must review actual activation and update matching receipt hash. No listener started by this lane.
requiredMode: config.readOnly and receipt.readOnly must both be boolean and equal. Missing/string/mismatched values refuse activation. Mode false requires separately reviewed activation, not automatic upgrade.
writeRejection: eth_sendRawTransaction single/mixed batch is rejected before ANY upstream request in readOnly:true mode. All existing request, method, origin, host, rate, size, concurrency, chain and genesis guards remain.
